request.description: A single circular Xbox-style gamepad A button icon for a Minecraft Java controller mod. Front view, straight-on flat 2D pixel art. The face is grass green enamel, with one large clearly readable ivory capital letter A centered. A thin dark charcoal pixel outline, simple gray stone rim with a subtle upper-left bevel. Clean bold silhouette, low detail, strong contrast, generous clear letter, fits completely in the canvas. No controller body, no scene, no extra words, no perspective, no decorative flourishes. Transparent background. Designed for a readable 32x32 game HUD icon.
request.color_palette: grass green button face, warm ivory capital A, charcoal outline, medium stone gray rim
